{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# First, verify that the '999999.99' QA entries are absent
qa_orders = data[data['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Remove commas and convert to float
data['revenue_clean'] = data['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter to only completed orders (exclude refunded)
completed_data = data[data['status'] == 'completed']

# Cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment to check for imbalance
channel_segment = pd.crosstab(completed_data['channel'], completed_data['customer_segment'])
print("\nCross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(channel_segment)

# Compute conversion rate by channel and by segment
conv_by_channel = completed_data.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
conv_by_segment = completed_data.groupby('customer_segment')['converted'].mean()

# Compute conversion rate within each segment, by channel
conv_by_channel_segment = completed_data.groupby(['customer_segment', 'channel'])['converted'].mean().unstack(level='channel')

# Compute the difference in conversion rate (email - paid_search) within each segment
conv_diff_by_segment = conv_by_channel_segment['email'] - conv_by_channel_segment['paid_search']

# Print all required numbers for evidence
print("\nConversion rate by channel:")
print(conv_by_channel)

print("\nConversion rate by customer_segment:")
print(conv_by_segment)

print("\nConversion rate by segment and channel (within segment):")
print(conv_by_channel_segment)

print("\nConversion rate difference (email - paid_search) by segment:")
print(conv_diff_by_segment)

# Return the key values
conv_by_channel, conv_by_segment, conv_by_channel_segment, conv_diff_by_segment"}
